title: Rollout Spotlight tutorial & contextual pinning screens
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a set of onboarding and quickstart UX assets that introduce the Rollouts feature via a 'Spotlight' guided tutorial. Focused deliverables: a compact tutorial sequence (3–4 screens) that surfaces canary/A-B/fallback concepts via spotlight tiles and contextual pin indicators; a set of annotated product screenshots for docs and in-product help; microcopy variations for pin/fallback states and a compact A/B comparison grid. Goals: reduce time-to-first-success for users creating a canary rollout, explain why pinning matters, and visually show how fallback policies behave under traffic surges. Must align with current Console theming and be accessible (contrast + screen-reader friendly).
acceptance_criteria: 3 tutorial spotlight screens (start, pin example, fallback simulation) exported as responsive PNGs (desktop 1365w and tablet 768w)
Annotated screenshots for docs: canary setup, variant traffic slider, pin toggles, fallback policy editor (with callouts)
Microcopy set for pin states (unpinned / pinned / pinned-overridden) reviewed and agreed by PM and Legal
Figma prototype with hotspots and two flows: create-canary and promote-pin with accessible labels and keyboard focus order
Design tokens documented for colors used in spotlight overlays and error/warning states
Handoff notes and a short QA checklist for engineering: element IDs, exported assets, and ARIA labels
assets_notes: Export layout: 2x PNG for retina, include 8px padding around cards. Use cutout mask for spotlight overlay to keep the underlying card readable. Ensure tooltip copy lines do not exceed 90 characters for responsive wrapping.
tasks: Finalize microcopy and localize into 4 languages (EN, FR, DE, JP)
Export assets at requested sizes and verify contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for body text
Add ARIA labels and keyboard focus order notes in handoff doc
Create a short 30s animated GIF showing fallback trigger and automatic traffic shift for docs
decisions: Use spotlight overlay rather than modal for onboarding to maintain context with Console UI
Animate traffic shift in docs GIF but keep in-product tutorial static to avoid motion distraction
Pin indicator will be a subtle blue border + pin icon with 'pinned' aria-label
Fallback severity will use amber for warning and red for hard-fail states per token-color tokens
testing_notes: QA: Verify spotlight does not trap focus; tabbing should move through highlights in logical order
QA: Validate screenshots render correctly at 75%, 100%, and 125% zoom for documentation capture
Dev: Provide test harness data to simulate 'traffic surge' event used in fallback simulation asset
